gates.description: Every file in expected-output-manifest.json exists, and the six schemas are present
Canonical data validates against the V2 JSON schemas
Every Core Food has a unique, identity-derived stable ID and unchanged source nutrition
Both Custom Foods are represented with source values preserved
All meal-options.json meals are represented once; the live-settings duplicate is not a source
Every ingredient, garnish and swap reference resolves to an existing Food ID; quantities > 0 g
No Library or Saved Meal stores P/C/F totals
Every Library Meal calculates through migration/macro-calc.js

Initial target seed is exactly Lift 150/293/70, Long Run 150/343/70, Rest 150/218/70 (P/C/F) and matches the legacy daily targets; data/targets.json is daily-only with canonical keys (its values may change after seeding)
No forbidden nutrition-unit key or value anywhere in canonical data, schemas or migration outputs
The migration generates no Days, Meal Instances or Saved Meals
No V2 runtime or canonical data file references live-settings-doc, CTC_FOOD, the M array, SLOT_TARGET or carbShiftByDayType
